title: Lilly's Pad | KEY.co
description_expanded: Lilly’s Pad is a beautifully curated coastal escape tucked into the vibrant charm of Santa Rosa Beach, just a quick stroll from the powdery white sands and turquoise waters of the Gulf. With six stylish bedrooms—including multiple king suites—and space to accommodate up to 14 guests, this pet-friendly retreat is ideal for families and groups seeking a blend of comfort, luxury, and effortless fun. A private heated pool serves as the centerpiece of the lush backyard oasis, where guests can grill, dine, and unwind beneath the stars. A complimentary golf cart and four bikes make it easy to explore the nearby boutiques, restaurants, and beaches of Gulf Place.
